datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: IPC classification data were collected by FEWS NET field enumerators across Somalia on a monthly basis throughout 2017. Geographic boundaries and IPC phase classifications were compiled into spatial datasets (GeoJSON/KML format) representing near-term food insecurity projections for February, June, and October 2017, with metadata on collection dates, scenarios, and assistance eligibility.
